gui.flansmodultimate.apocalypse_choice.e:
This world does not have the Apocalypse dimension.

Adding it is permanent: afterwards, the world can no longer be opened if Flan's Mod Ultimate is removed. Consider backing the world up first. Keeping it without leaves the world loadable without the mod.

You will not be asked again for this world.
gui.flansmodultimate.apocalypse_choice.n:
Should this world include the Apocalypse dimension?

A world created with it can no longer be opened if Flan's Mod Ultimate is removed later. A world created without it can still be opened without the mod; only Flan's blocks, items and vehicles would disappear.

This choice is permanent for this world.

options.flansmodultimate.aimPose.tooltip: How your arms hold a gun, as other players see you. Enforced keeps a held gun raised; Dynamic raises it only while you fire or aim. Shields always stay raised.
options.flansmodultimate.armoredBlastRes: Armored Blast Resistance K Pa Per Mm
options.flansmodultimate.disableSprintHi: Disable Sprint Hip Fire By Default
options.flansmodultimate.distance.tracki: Server tracking setting: %s blocks. Server view distance and tracking scaling may limit actual visibility.
options.flansmodultimate.distantHorizons: Show driveables beyond the entity render distance as simplified shapes on the far terrain, including those the server reports from beyond the tracking range, if it allows it.
Draw full driveable models to the chunk edge. This extends the configured size-based cutoff. Off uses the configured cutoff and distant contact shapes beyond it.
Show large explosions beyond the particle range as a flash, a fireball and a smoke column, if the server allows it.
Use Distant Horizons to show and measure what lies beyond the vanilla render distance. The settings below only apply while this is on.
Vehicle rangefinders measure the far terrain beyond the loaded chunks. Such ranges are approximate and shown with a ~.
options.flansmodultimate.driveableRender: Scales the collision-box-based render distance and Minecraft Entity Distance setting. The Distant Horizons chunk-edge option can extend this cutoff.
options.flansmodultimate.driveableTracki: Server tracking range in blocks for driveables, seats and wheels. Applies live without a restart; server view distance and tracking scaling still apply.
options.flansmodultimate.enableGpuModelC: Experimental GPU geometry cache for vehicles and guns. Applies immediately. Disable if visuals or performance worsen. Some rendering modes use the standard path.
options.flansmodultimate.entityAimPose.t: How humanoid mobs hold guns. Enforced keeps a held gun raised; Dynamic raises it only while the mob fires. Shields always stay raised. Applies to the whole server.
options.flansmodultimate.flanNpcRenderDi: Scales the bounding-box-based render distance for Flan-model NPCs and opted-in soldiers. Requires the NPC module; no distant NPC proxies are available.
options.flansmodultimate.flanNpcTracking: Server tracking range in blocks for Flan-model NPCs and opted-in soldiers. Applies live without a restart; requires the NPC module.
options.flansmodultimate.gpuModelCacheMe: Video memory the GPU model cache may use. Automatic takes a sixteenth of video memory, from 128 to 512 MiB. Raise it if /flansrenderstats reports evictions of meshes drawn in the last two frames.
Automatic on this computer: %s MiB (%s MiB video memory reported).
Automatic on this computer: %s MiB (the driver does not report video memory).
Snap between impostor presets for distant vehicles and planes. Stronger presets switch sooner, subject to image quality. Off disables impostors; Custom keeps the current values. Model LOD stays separate.

Projected threshold: %s px
Minimum distance: %s blocks
Preferred distance: %s blocks
Quality multiplier: ×%s
Base capture: %s px, %s yaw views
options.flansmodultimate.lodPreset.toolt: Snap between model and tank-track LOD presets. Stronger presets hide small distant parts sooner. Off keeps full model detail; Custom keeps the current values. Impostors stay separate.
options.flansmodultimate.lodPreset.value:
Near part cutoff: %s px
Far part cutoff: %s px (detail ×%s)
Track simplification: %s px
Track grouping: %s px
options.flansmodultimate.maxFragSparks.t: Maximum fragmentation sparks from one explosion. The overall Max Particles Per Tick budget may limit the visible result further.
options.flansmodultimate.muzzleFlashStyl: Choose the muzzle flash appearance. Applies immediately to held, deployed and mounted guns. Packs with only one style use their available model.
options.flansmodultimate.playerAimPose.t: How every player holds guns. Free Choice lets each player pick with their own Aim Pose setting; Enforced and Dynamic apply to everyone. Applies to the whole server.
options.flansmodultimate.server.disableC: Hides the crosshair of every player holding a non-melee gun. Applies to the whole server.
options.flansmodultimate.server.driveabl: Whether driveables destroy the blocks their collision points strike. Applies to the whole server.
options.flansmodultimate.server.explosio: Whether Flan's Mod explosions can break blocks at all. Applies to the whole server.
options.flansmodultimate.server.flanExpl: Whether blocks destroyed by Flan's Mod explosions drop their items. Applies to the whole server.
options.flansmodultimate.server.shootabl: Whether guns and grenades can break glass. Applies to the whole server.
tooltip.flansmodultimate.glove.handling: Improves gun, sword or axe handling when enchanted and held in off hand
tooltip.flansmodultimate.hold_to_throw: Hold attack to throw overhand, hold use to toss underhand
tooltip.flansmodultimate.physics.speedSc: Speeds scaled to %sx by the server config
